name: web-horizontal-stepper-with-connecting-line-progress-and-step-labels
title: Wide horizontal stepper with a black checked circle, a solid line to a black '2' circle and a pending grey '3', labels centred beneath
whatItIs: A white frame with three circles spaced far apart on a horizontal line: a black check, a black 2 joined by a solid black line and a pale grey 3 with no connecting line yet, each with a bold label and grey description centred below and a content line 'Step Step 2 content'.
whatItMeans: Clear and airy; a line that fills shows progress between steps.
techniques: Join completed steps with a solid line.

vocabulary.definition: A line connecting steps that fills as you advance.
A numbered or checked circle marking a step.
A title and description under a marker.
A stepper spread across the page width.
